one_liner: Lark Open Platform offers a broad REST API with user_access_token (OAuth 2.0) and app-based tenant_access_token; custom apps are created self-serve, and the vendor publishes an official open-source lark-openapi-mcp server.
auth_notes: user_access_token acts on behalf of a user (OAuth 2.0 redirect URL configured per README); tenant_access_token is the app's own identity, minted from App ID/App Secret (classed OTHER). Tokens are sent as Authorization: Bearer and last up to 7200 seconds.
access_notes: Homepage has a CREATE APP entry point and the MCP README says to create an app in the console and obtain App ID and App Secret. Pricing/quota details for Starter were not in the fetched pages, so free status is not explicitly confirmed.
blocker_notes: Per-tenant setup: each customer tenant must install the app and permission scopes may need tenant admin approval; quota limits apply on lower editions (per draft, not re-verified in the pages provided).
